chapter: Harry Parker's, the district and its characters
title: An organized band with a girl pianist, and Manuel Sales
summary: Asked about female vocalists, Dawson describes a band with a woman pianist from St. Catharines, August Lanoix on tuba, T-Boy Remy and others, in which Manuel Sales later replaced him.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Did any band have a female vocalist around here? Um, now, uh, we had a band, let's see, uh, Sales was in that band, too. I can't think of the name. I used to have a picture. I was looking for it last week. It got, I got misplaced there. Uh, it was an organized band, too. And, uh, we had a girl play piano. She used to sing. She was a vocalist and she played piano on us there. And they had, uh, let me see what they had played, uh, played bass tuba with us. Uh, what's he, he plays string bass now. August Langwell. Oh, yeah? He was playing bass tuba then. They had, I was playing, uh, banjo, and August was playing, uh, bass tuba. And, uh, Dominic Remy was playing trumpet. T-boy, we used to call him T-boy. And, uh, a hall. Both of the hall boys was playing saxophone. And, uh, I was playing saxophone. Harris. And, uh, let's see who we had. Nicky. They had, they had one we called, the drum player, we called him Nicky. I never did know what his first name was. A little dark fella. He was a good drummer. Well that was, I forget the name of that band now, it was a famous band then, but Sales can tell you the name of it. Did you manage Sales? Manuel Sales will tell you because he played banjo in my place. I got out, and after I got out of the band, then Sales took my place.
Who was the woman that played the piano?

I'm trying to think of her name. She used to play piano at, she was an organist at St. Catharines Church. She'd come from back in town, but she was a good old piano player, she could read music too. Now Manuel Sales will be able to tell you that now, because he shouldn't. You just get to balance that from him. I just can't memorize it, so you've been so long.
